name: Smoq Games 26
summary:
Smoq Games 26 is here!
Open packs with a awesome new animation and grow your collection of cards. Get the best packs, create an unbeatable Draft, finish Squad Building Challenges, and jump into online tournaments.
You can even trade cards with friends to upgrade your squad.
Packs are unlimited. Can you assemble the strongest team and beat your friends in Smoq Games 26?
